title: Kiln model physics (assets/physics.json), format 1
description: The cloth and bone chains a mod asks the cook to write into its models (tools/modelcook/cook/physics.py; docs/kiln/modding/models.md#physics). A body block's cloth and chains (Kiln.Blocks ModelClothBlock, ModelChainBlock) become the same tree; a model both name is refused. The game simulates them with its own cloth and chain code on a player's machine; a dedicated server only serves the cooked files. Writing them needs the cook features modelcook.cloth and modelcook.chains2, off until their guided client check passes: a recipe turns them on for one mod with "experimental": ["modelcook.cloth", "modelcook.chains2"] in assets/cook.json. Strict JSON: no comments, no trailing commas, a key twice, NaN and an unknown key are errors. Every refusal of the cook starts with the field path.

models.description: Model file -> its cloth and chains. The key is the glTF file's path in the mod (forward slashes, no leading /, no . or .. parts), as a body block's or a recipe step's model names it. One model once (also not in another case: one file on Windows).

propertyNames.x-kiln-message: a glTF file's path in the mod, as models/banner.gltf

cloth.description: Cloth meshes, each a glTF primitive. At most 255 per model; a primitive once.

mesh.description: The glTF mesh, by its index in the file.

primitive.description: The primitive of that mesh, by its index.

particleIds.description: One id per POSITION element of the primitive. Equal ids weld the copies a UV or normal seam made: they sit within 1e-6 m and carry the same skin. Particles are numbered in the order their id first appears. Absent: every vertex is its own particle.

pin.description: One value per particle (in particle order): 1 holds it on the model, 0 lets it hang, between makes it heavier and limits its motion. Every connected piece of cloth needs a particle with 1.

massKg.description: The whole cloth's mass, spread over its particles by the area around each.

stiffness.description: One stiffness for stretch and bend.

colliders.description: Spheres and capsules the cloth does not pass through, in bind pose (metres, glTF axes). The colliders of all cloth entries of a model are its one list, each once: at most 32 spheres, a capsule counting as two.

joint.description: The skeleton joint it follows (all its weight), or null: rigid on the model.

b.description: Not at a's centre; the same joint as a (the format has one skin record per capsule).

end.description: An end of a capsule: a sphere without "type".

rootJoint.description: The first joint that swings; its parent stays animated. A name of the glTF's skeleton.

tipJoint.description: The last joint, below the root along one branch: 2 to 8 joints from root to tip.

particleMassKg.description: The mass of one moving joint, not of the chain.

stiffness.description: The game's own coefficient (no unit claimed).

bendStiffness.description: The game's own coefficient (no unit claimed).
